P1_unconfigured_work_was_invisible.what_was_wrong: An empty attachment made `PooledManagerOperations.recover` loop over no workers, so a REAL accepted control offer was invisible: the manager reported `recovered={abandoned:[], recoverable:[]}` and an ordinary idle tick, while the same control store's own recovery called that offer recoverable. The constructor comparison against `_required_workers` is one answer at one moment and says nothing about work that arrives after attachment, or about control work with no matching Job row.
what_it_is_now: `worker_manager.outstanding_offers(store)` -- a new READ through the same owned crossing every other offer read uses. It answers the live states (issued, accepted, claimed) and ACTS ON NOTHING; `recover_on_restart` answers a related question and expires and abandons, which is why it could not be the reader.

`stage_execution.unconfigured_work(job_store, control_store)` names Job rows, an active pool generation, live stage allocations and live control offers -- offers separately, so control work with no Job row counts.
it runs AT STARTUP in `operations_from`, before the first durable act, and ON EVERY RESUME in a spelled `StageExecution.recover`, which is what `manager.reconcile` calls each tick.
the refusal names each thing and says `Nothing was expired, abandoned, repaired or executed`; every check asserts the foreign work is exactly where it was afterwards.
